title: Setup lock race probe: bound the start barrier and tighten the NFS/NLM ADR sentence (#294 round 2 findings 1 and 2)
description: Non-blocking findings from the #294 round 2 APPROVE (recorded verbatim on WCLI-152). (1) test/fixtures/setup-lock-race-probe.ts and the race helper in test/setup.test.ts: the start barrier has no deadline on either side. If one probe dies before writing its ready file, the parent polls until the test timeout with no diagnostic and the other probes spin on the go file forever, orphaned at full CPU. (2) ADR 0001 NFS/CIFS sentence omits that cross-host exclusion depends on the network lock manager (a nolock or local_lock mount makes flock host-local) and that flock over SMB or NFS on macOS can return ENOTSUP, reported as setup_in_progress; the line is also unwrapped. Keep the Docs profile within budget (verification.toml sits near its 20000-token cap).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The probe exits non-zero after a bounded spin on the go file, and the parent fails fast with the probe stderr when a worker exits before it is ready or the barrier deadline passes, so no probe is left spinning
The ADR 0001 limit sentence states the lock-manager dependency and the macOS ENOTSUP reporting, wrapped like the surrounding paragraph, and lore check exits 0
